description: This file contains shell functions for parsing and modifying boot configuration files, including validation, retrieving, setting, and toggling bootstrap partition settings based on magic number validation and binary data manipulation.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic numbers at the start and end of the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions defined in the boot config file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Finds the index of a specified partition name within the boot config file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Gets the primary boot index for a given partition name.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot index for a specified partition.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot index between 0 and 1 for a specific partition.
